statements: The Scottish Administration consists of the office-holders in the Scottish Administration and the members of the staff of the Scottish Administration, as provided by section 126(6) of the Scotland Act 1998.

Office-holders in the Scottish Administration are, under section 126(7)(a), members of the Scottish Government and junior Scottish Ministers, together with the holders of offices in the Scottish Administration which are not ministerial offices.

Section 126(8)(a) of the Scotland Act 1998 names three non-ministerial offices expressly: the Registrar General of Births, Deaths and Marriages for Scotland, the Keeper of the Registers of Scotland, and the Keeper of the Records of Scotland.

Section 126(8)(b) allows any other office of a description specified in an Order in Council to be a non-ministerial office in the Scottish Administration, so a complete list cannot be produced from primary legislation alone.
Where the Orders in Council specifying further offices cannot all be retrieved, the answer should state that the list is incomplete rather than presenting a partial list as complete.
